# Kiln & Crumb Bakery

> Neighborhood bakery in Riverton, VA: long-fermented sourdough, laminated pastry and seasonal galettes. Walk in for the morning bake or preorder for pickup.

Address: 214 Mill Street, Riverton, VA 22651
Phone: (703) 555-0142
Email: hello@kilnandcrumb.example

## Hours
- Tuesday – Friday: 7 a.m. to 3 p.m.
- Saturday – Sunday: 8 a.m. to 2 p.m.
- Monday: closed

## Daily bake
- Country Sourdough, $9.00 (Vegan): 36-hour ferment, crackling crust, open crumb.
- Seeded Rye, $10.00 (Vegan): Dense Nordic-style loaf with sunflower, flax and caraway.
- Butter Croissant, $4.25: Three days of lamination with cultured butter.
- Cardamom Knot, $4.75: Swedish-style, brushed with syrup and pearl sugar.
- Olive & Rosemary Focaccia, $6.00 (Vegan): Sold by the slab; dimpled, oily, very good.
- Seasonal Fruit Galette, $5.50: Whatever the orchard sent this week.

## Frequently asked questions
- Can I preorder bread? Yes. Call or email by 2 p.m. the day before and we will hold your order at the counter until noon.
- What time does bread sell out? On weekends the sourdough is usually gone by 11 a.m. Weekday mornings are calmer; preordering guarantees a loaf.
- Do you have gluten-free options? No. Everything is baked in one room full of wheat flour, so we cannot promise anything is safe for celiac guests.
- Do you supply restaurants and cafés? We bake wholesale bread for a small number of local kitchens, delivered Tuesday to Saturday. Email us for the wholesale list.
- Is there parking? Free street parking on Mill Street and a public lot one block east on Second Avenue.
